scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../webapp && npm install && cd ../e2e && npm install
scripts.install:browsers: cd e2e && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.test:all: npm run test:server -- run && npm run test:webapp -- run && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage:all: concurrently "cd server && npx vitest --coverage run" "cd webapp && npx vitest --coverage run"
scripts.remove_merged: git branch --merged | grep -Ev '(^\*|main)' | xargs git branch -d && git fetch -p
scripts.format:all: npm run format:server && npm run format:webapp && npm run format:e2e
scripts.format:check:all: npm run format:check:server && npm run format:check:webapp && npm run format:check:e2e
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:webapp
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:webapp && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:webapp
